defs.def: an amount of sth that is provided or available to be used 供应量；供给量；储备

ex.s: Since the 1930s, Mclntyre said, the biggest factors driving up water stress in the state have been rising temperatures, which cause trees to lose more water to the air, and earlier snowmelt, which reduces the water supply available to trees during the dry season.
ex.t: 麦金太尔说，自20世纪30年代以来，导致该州水压力上升的最大因素是气温上升——气温上升导致树木向空气中散失更多水分——以及融雪提前——融雪提前减少了旱季树木可用的供水量。

ex.s: We’ve also seen droughts and floods caused by these changes, which affect the water supply downstream.
ex.t: 我们还看到这些变化造成的干旱和洪水，影响了下游的供水。

ex.s: I no longer felt the weight of my clothes, or of my shoes, of my air supply, or my thick helmet, inside which my head shook like a nut in its shell.
ex.t: 我不再感受到衣服的重量，或鞋子的，或供氧设备，或厚头盔的——我的头在里面摇得像坚果壳里的核仁。

ex.s: the rich food supply and our unchanged brains
ex.t: 毫不奇怪，这些新概念激发我们建立新的宇宙模型。
一个以农业为基础的社会。

defs.def: the things such as food, medicines, fuel, etc. that are needed by a group of people, for example an army or expedition （军队或探险队等的）补给，补给品

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: How long can the Saint Lukas work with one supply?
ex.t: 圣卢卡斯用一次补给可以工作多长时间？

defs.def: the act of supplying sth 供应；供给；提供；补给

ex.s: The innovative design requires little effort to achieve a reliable weekly supply of fresh greens.
ex.t: 这一创新设计只需很少的投入，就能实现稳定的每周新鲜蔬菜供应。

ex.s: To ensure the supply of energy.
Now, reduced energy supplies and environmental pollution have led to more advances in the technology of new energy vehicles.
ex.t: 现在，能源供应的减少和环境污染促进了新能源汽车技术的更多进步。

ex.s: Food waste is a growing concern in the restaurant, supermarket, and supply chain industries.
ex.t: 食物浪费正日益成为餐饮、超市和供应链行业关注的问题。

ex.s: For the biggest stadiums in the world, we have used data supplied by the World Atlas list so far, which ranks them by their stated permanent capacity, as well as updated information from official stadium websites.
ex.t: 对于世界上最大的体育场，我们目前使用了世界地图册提供的数据，该数据按公布的固定容量对它们排名，并参考了官方体育场网站的更新信息。

ex.s: [Now tick the solutions that you think are most effective to supply Africa with fresh water.] ?
ex.t: [现在打勾你认为最能为非洲提供淡水的解决办法。 ]

ex.s: The second principle is to loosen the control that providers of on-line services have over data and give more to those who supply them.
ex.t: 第二条原则是放松在线服务提供商对数据的控制，将更多控制权交给数据提供者。

ex.s: To make sure your appliance is in fact off, remove the plug from its power supply.
ex.t: 为了确保你的电器确实关闭了，请拔掉电源插头。

ex.s: supplying useful information of your potential buyers
ex.t: 提供企业管理方面的专业建议
